The failing test is `test_token_provisioned_in_the_environment_is_sent_as_bearer`. It expects the deployment to provide `DNS_API_TOKEN`, and that variable isn't set in this environment, so `DnsClient.from_env()` correctly raises `MissingCredentialsError`. I didn't set a placeholder token or look for one elsewhere, since the test is meant to check a real provisioned value. Run it with `DNS_API_TOKEN` set and it should pass.
